svg.title: Slant animated mark — held light and diffusing color splash
svg.desc: A pale champagne-white light blooms and holds between the eyes for two seconds, travels to the nib breather hole and glows there for two seconds, then descends the slit and bursts into wavy, scattering cyan, teal, violet, magenta, and peach-colored clouds and droplets that diffuse and fade. The animation loops every nine seconds.
